title: Languages decidable in layered polynomial size
statement: A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet is decidable by layered circuits of polynomial size if there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that $L$ has layered circuit complexity at most the function $n\mapsto a(n+1)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet
